bio.text: Jane Garibay, a Democrat, has represented District 60 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2019 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
She graduated from Windsor High School in 1973 and began her career as an English teacher, later working as a Spanish teacher and, from 1994, as a recreation supervisor for the town of Windsor.
She later became director of the Windsor Chamber of Commerce and First Town Downtown, Incorporated.
